Pope Francis' private diary details alleged visions of the devil

Pope Francis' private diary entries reportedly describe alleged encounters and visions of the devil and hell. The diary entries, published by Vatican journalist Javier Martinez-Brocal, include claims that the Pope saw and heard the devil. The Washington Post reported that the diary reveals torment and visions of the devil, while other outlets noted the Pope's private struggles with faith and power.
